title: Fragment::write_to missing validation for content_len overflow
description: Line 156-157: `let content_len = self.payload.len() + if self.is_all_1() { MIC_LENGTH } else { 0 }; let needed = content_len + 2;` - While payload.len() is bounded by the earlier TILE_SIZE check (line 147-150), the addition `content_len + 2` could theoretically overflow on 16-bit usize platforms. Consider using saturating_add or checked_add for defense-in-depth, or add a comment noting usize >= 32 is assumed.
